quote: monotherapy or adjunctive therapy in the treatment of partial-onset seizures in adults
note: Focal aware seizure is a subtype of partial-onset seizures.

quote: treatment of moderate to severe acute pain, including postoperative pain, in adults
note: Postoperative pain explicitly named.

quote: indicated as a diluent for the intrathecal administration of methotrexate sodium and cytarabine for the prevention or treatment of meningeal leukemia or lymphocytic lymphoma
note: Phosphate solution is only a diluent; lymphoma is treated by the co-administered cytotoxics.

quote: indicated for the treatment of refractory hypotension in adults with septic or other distributive shock
note: Hypotension is the treated condition.

quote: for nausea associated with gastroenteritis
note: Label treats nausea, not the underlying gastroenteritis.

quote: Adult patients with previously untreated Stage III or IV classical Hodgkin lymphoma (cHL)
note: Multiple lymphoma types indicated; lymphoma is a near parent describing the indications.

quote: Maintenance treatment of asthma, in adults not adequately controlled
note: Asthma named in EMA indication.

quote: Treatment of travelers' diarrhea (TD) caused by noninvasive strains of Escherichia coli
note: Generic 'infection' is a whole disease class; only E. coli travelers' diarrhea is indicated.

quote: allergic conjunctivitis, keratitis, allergic corneal marginal ulcers, herpes zoster ophthalmicus, iritis and iridocyclitis, chorioretinitis, anterior segment inflammation, diffuse posterior uveitis and choroiditis, optic neuritis
note: Optic neuritis listed among ophthalmic indications.
Edge term 'Myelogenous' is a bare adjective; label indicates myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms with FGFR1 rearrangement, mapping unclear.

quote: in adult patients with elevated triglyceride (TG) levels (≥ 150 mg/dL) and established cardiovascular disease or diabetes mellitus
note: Diabetes is a population risk criterion, not the treated condition.

quote: chronic weight management in: 30 kg/m 2 or greater (obese), or 27 kg/m 2 or greater (overweight)
note: BMI is an eligibility measure, not a treated disease.
Complex regional pain syndrome is not mentioned; indications are depression/anxiety-type disorders.

quote: Cholera caused by Vibrio cholerae .
note: Cholera listed in doxycycline indications.

quote: Monotherapy and adjunctive therapy of complex partial seizures
note: Complex partial seizures are focal-onset seizures; edge is a near parent.

quote: non-valvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF), with one or more risk factors, such as prior stroke or transient ischemic attack (TIA); age ≥ 75 years; heart failure (NYHA Class ≥ II); diabetes mellitus
note: Diabetes is only a listed risk factor in the population.

quote: Torisel is indicated for the first-line treatment of adult patients with advanced renal-cell carcinoma (RCC)
note: RCC named.

quote: prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with initial and repeat courses of emetogenic cancer chemotherapy
note: Cancer is the background; treated condition is CINV.
Spine pain is not named; label covers MS spasticity with concomitant pain of flexor spasms and spinal cord disease, not spinal pain.

quote: Baricitinib is indicated for the treatment of active juvenile idiopathic arthritis in patients 2 years of age and older
note: JIA named in EMA indication.

quote: KABIVEN may be used to prevent essential fatty acid deficiency or treat negative nitrogen balance in adult patients.
note: Combination PN product indicated to prevent EFAD; combo indications count.
Hepatic veno-occlusive disease not mentioned; only hepatic failure in warnings.

quote: indicated for the chronic management of hyperuricemia in adult patients with gout
note: Hyperuricemia is the treated condition.

quote: indicated for the acute treatment of migraine attacks with or without aura in adults
note: Migraine without aura explicitly covered.

quote: Vigabatrin tablets are indicated as monotherapy for pediatric patients with infantile spasms 1 month to 2 years of age
note: Infantile spasms named.

quote: HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
note: Stage IV breast cancer is metastatic breast cancer.

quote: radioactive diagnostic agent indicated as an adjunct to other diagnostic evaluations ... in adult patients with: suspected Parkinsonian syndromes (PS) or suspected dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB)
note: Diagnostic imaging agent; dementia is the diagnostic setting, not treated.

quote: VIBATIV is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with complicated skin and skin structure infections (cSSSI)
note: cSSSI named.

quote: seasonal or perennial allergic rhinitis; asthma; contact dermatitis; atopic dermatitis; serum sickness
note: Contact dermatitis listed.
Abdominal migraine is not mentioned; label covers migraine with or without aura and episodic migraine in adults.

quote: indicated for the management of severe and persistent pain in opioid tolerant patients, that requires an opioid analgesic
note: Weak: urinary tract pain only as a subtype of generically indicated severe persistent pain.

quote: PAH associated with corrected simple congenital heart disease
note: Congenital heart disease is the PAH background; PAH is treated.

quote: SAVAYSA is indicated for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE)
note: Lower-limb DVT is a subtype of DVT.

quote: Adults with overweight in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbid condition
note: Overweight named (phentermine/topiramate).

quote: adult patients with intermediate or poor risk advanced renal cell carcinoma, as a first-line treatment in combination with ipilimumab
note: RCC named.

quote: indicated for the treatment of neurogenic detrusor overactivity (NDO) in pediatric patients 6 years of age and older
note: NDO named.

quote: Urinary Tract Infections (complicated and uncomplicated), including pyelonephritis and cystitis (initial and recurrent)
note: Cystitis named.
